blocks.note: Choose stressed or clitic forms, distinguish direct, indirect, and reflexive functions, and place a single clitic with finite, imperative, and multi-verb constructions; the hygiene gate excludes the one judgment-dependent correction.
Replace complements with an unsplit, correctly ordered clitic cluster and apply the me/te/glie/se/ce/ve forms before lo, la, li, le, or ne; judgment-dependent translations are excluded.
Translate current constructions with ecco, everyday plural gli versus formal postverbal loro, propositional lo, and lexicalized feminine la; the source-flagged open translation is excluded.
Replace an already established place or a-complement with ci and form current esserci, volerci, and related locative constructions; the judgment-dependent final item is excluded.
Use ne for di-complements, quantities, partitives, and motion away, preserving the quantifier and required participle agreement.
Choose between a transitive verb and its lexically reflexive or change-of-state counterpart, then conjugate the selected verb in context.
Rewrite plural events with reciprocal si while keeping tense, person, and any preposition required by the underlying verb.
Replace a generic human subject with finite third-person singular indefinite si without turning non-finite clauses into unsupported si constructions.
Form passive si with verb agreement, then distinguish it from indefinite si and combine indefinite si with reflexive verbs or object clitics as ci si and lo/la/li/le si.
Move si constructions into a compound tense, selecting singular essere and the participle pattern licensed by the verb, passive subject, reflexive construction, or object clitic.
